page.overview:
What is Chromium?

Chromium allows the burner to, with physical contact, deplete the metals in another with an effect similar to that of Aluminum. A Chromium misting is called a Leecher. Chromium is an elemental metal. A Spinner ferring can save up luck to use later. Category:Magic Systems Category:Cosmere Category:Mistborn
